{"question":{"id":"q33","question":"风信子是如何得知苏天晴发布的视频的？白灵做了什么？","readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":90},"group":"boundary","category":"knowledge","expected":"白灵先看到视频并震惊，称视频很重要，强行把手机塞给南小风，还按屏幕播放视频。","certainty":"supported","evidence":[{"chapter":6,"paragraph":82,"quote":"可白灵却满脸震惊地飞到书桌前，朝埋头苦干的南小风举起手中的手机。"},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":85,"quote":"“这个视频很重要！你赶紧看看吧！”"},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":86,"quote":"白灵急得翅膀扑扇，强行把手机塞到南小风手里。"},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":90,"quote":"白灵伸手按了一下手机屏幕，视频播放。"}]},"answer":{"queries":6,"sourceQueries":5,"exhausted":true,"answer":{"text":"在当前阅读范围（第6章第90段）内，只能确定：白灵拿着手机飞来找南小风（风信子），惊呼“小风你快看！快看这个视频！”并强调“这个视频很重要！你赶紧看看吧！”，然后白灵把手机塞到南小风手里，南小风看到“魔法少女狐狐official？”，白灵说“不是！你看她的第一个视频！”并伸手按屏幕让视频播放。但原文尚未直接说明风信子（南小风）是如何“得知”苏天晴发布该视频的——只显示白灵主动把视频/手机展示给她；苏天晴是否即“魔法少女狐狐official”、以及白灵如何获得该视频，在读到的证据中均未明确。","status":"partial","recordIds":["source-c06"],"sources":[{"chapter":6,"paragraph":82},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":83},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":85},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":86},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":88},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":89},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":90}]},"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"source","chapter":6,"query":"风信子","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10},{"command":"source","chapter":6,"query":"苏天晴","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10},{"command":"source","chapter":6,"query":"白灵","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-6","sourceManifest":"manifest:3739db56713af694","knowledgeRevision":6,"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":114},"contentHash":"d0f3a8d6ed8fc2fd84a9f3d1ec3405b033a5c2569861939f2e493649de3dc8f2"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":90},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":4,"text":"魔法少女风信子被怪人抓住，失去往日的灵动，只剩下惊惧与恐慌，在月光下无助地哀鸣。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":10,"text":"自己是反派没错，重生后的人生阅历倒也算丰富，但作为魔法少女的经验可远远比不上那个风信子。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":13,"text":"要是咱把风信子的真名给曝光出去……岂不是能给她制造出巨大的窘迫状况吗……？"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":53,"text":"南小风，或者说魔法少女风信子，正在绝赞补作业中。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":62,"text":"——昨晚，魔法少女风信子前去绿心公园对抗怪人，被不知名的魔法少女暗算，整整七个小时后才被察觉情况的英雄协会给解救出来。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":90},"chapters":[1,2,3,4,5,6],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":5,"returned":5},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-6","sourceManifest":"manifest:3739db56713af694","knowledgeRevision":6,"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":114},"contentHash":"d0f3a8d6ed8fc2fd84a9f3d1ec3405b033a5c2569861939f2e493649de3dc8f2"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":90},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":3,"text":"看到这个问题的第一瞬间，苏天晴脑子里出现了昨天晚上的场景："},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":6,"text":"但苏天晴自己也很清楚，昨天那样的状况完全是借助强化后的黑狼怪人才实现的，并非自己的真正实力。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":12,"text":"反复翻阅着秘典，看着那一行惊心动魄的盒打击，苏天晴心里冒出了一个危险的想法。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":17,"text":"“看来只能花些神典石来消灾了呢。”苏天晴呢喃自语。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":25,"text":"没有丝毫犹豫，在用一声疑惑的轻呼表达了心中困惑后，苏天晴果断将它买下。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":30,"text":"可即便解决了第二个任务的前置，“如何让魔法少女窘迫”这个问题依然像个梦魇一样萦绕在苏天晴脑子里。"},{"type"
